title: [RFE] [Openconnect] nm plasma applet should support PKCS11 usercerts
line: OpenConnect VPN settings can now use a user certificate stored on a smart card or security token, picked from a list or kept when saving, in both the current and the new settings page.
explanation: Both OpenConnect editors treated the certificate and key fields as local file paths only. In the widget editor a PKCS#11 URI (pkcs11:...) set up elsewhere, for example with nm-connection-editor, was saved back as an empty string; the new QML editor showed such a URI as a mangled file: URL and dropped any pkcs11: URI (or plain path) typed into the field, so in both the certificate was silently removed. Neither offered a way to choose a certificate from a token. The change keeps pkcs11: URIs unchanged in both editors and adds a button next to User Certificate in each that lists the certificates on smart cards and tokens through a shared p11-kit helper in plasmanm_editor, which loads the PKCS#11 modules in a worker thread so a slow or unplugged reader can't freeze the settings window.

commits.message:
openconnect: allow user certificates from smart cards and tokens

Both OpenConnect editors dropped PKCS#11 certificate URIs on saving and
could only pick certificate files. Keep pkcs11: URIs as they are and add
a button that lists the certificates on tokens, searched in a thread.

BUG: 514263

media.caption: Current (widget) editor: connection with a token certificate after changing an unrelated option and saving: the User Certificate is gone (NetworkManager now has usercert='').
Current (widget) editor: same steps with the fix: the pkcs11: URI is still there after saving and reopening, stored unchanged.
Current (widget) editor: user Certificate only offers a file chooser.
Current (widget) editor: new token button next to User Certificate lists the certificates on the security token.
New QML editor: a token URI typed into User Certificate (left) is gone after Apply and reopening (right); NetworkManager no longer has a usercert.
With the fix: the typed token URI is still there after Apply and reopening, and a typed private key path is kept too.
New QML editor: an existing token URI is shown as a broken file: URL (pkcs11:...%2520...), with only a file chooser.
With the fix: the new token button next to User Certificate lists the certificates on the security token.
Current editor with a PKCS#11 module that takes 8 s to start: the token button is disabled while it searches (left) and the window keeps working, here typing a proxy (right).
New QML editor with the same slow module: the picker shows a busy indicator (left); Cancel closes it at once and the form keeps taking input during the search (right).

review.text: Good direction and solid UX: keeping pkcs11: URIs intact in both editors, scanning tokens off the UI thread via QtConcurrent with QFuture::then(this, ...), and skipping p11-kit trust modules directly address the RFE, and the auth PIN prompt was verified to already work on master. However, placing TokenCertificates in plasmanm_editor and making plasmanm_editorqml link plasmanm_editor introduces a new dependency from the new QML editor onto the legacy QtWidgets editor library (despite the notes claiming it was already linked by both). There are also a few small correctness and polish issues around duplicate certificate display names in the widget picker, missing <cstdlib> include, case-sensitive URI matching, empty token labels, and accessibility on the icon-only QML button.
changes: Move TokenCertificates out of plasmanm_editor into plasmanm_internal (or a small widget-free shared target) so plasmanm_editorqml does not gain a dependency on the legacy QtWidgets plasmanm_editor library.

In vpn/openconnect/openconnectwidget.cpp, avoid looking up the selected certificate by display string (names.indexOf(name)), which always picks the first entry when two certificates share the same label or are unnamed.

In libs/editor/tokencertificates.cpp, add #include <cstdlib> for free(), match pkcs11: case-insensitively per RFC 7512, and handle an empty tokenLabel in displayName() so it does not format as "name ()".
In libs/editorqml/qml/vpn/openconnect/Openconnect.qml, set display: QQC2.AbstractButton.IconOnly and text (or Accessible.name) on the new icon-only token button for screen reader accessibility.
